Package neqsim.process.util.optimizer

Class PlantConstraintParticipant

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.optimizer.PlantConstraintParticipant
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<PlantConstraintParticipant>
public final class PlantConstraintParticipant extends Object implements Serializable, Comparable<PlantConstraintParticipant>
Immutable member of an aggregated plant constraint.

A participant either already uses the registered target unit and basis, or declares an explicit affine conversion target = source * factor + offset. The registry never guesses conversions between unlike engineering units or rate/reference bases.
